faq.question: Ce convertisseur JPG vers PNG est-il vraiment gratuit ?
faq.answer: Oui. Il n'y a aucune limite, aucun filigrane ni frais cachés. Toutes les conversions s'exécutent localement dans votre navigateur.

faq.question: Mes images sont-elles envoyées sur un serveur ?
faq.answer: Non. Cet outil utilise l'API Canvas et les Web Workers de votre navigateur pour convertir les images localement — vos fichiers ne quittent jamais votre appareil.

faq.question: Puis-je convertir des fichiers HEIC de mon iPhone ?
faq.answer: Oui, les fichiers HEIC sont pris en charge et convertis automatiquement au format PNG standard.

faq.question: Y a-t-il une limite pour les conversions par lots ?
faq.answer: Aucune limite artificielle n'est imposée — la seule contrainte est la mémoire disponible sur votre appareil.

faq.question: Will converting JPG to PNG make the file larger?
faq.answer: Usually yes. PNG uses lossless compression, so a photo with lots of detail or gradients often becomes several times larger than the original JPG. If file size matters more than lossless quality, stick with JPG or try WebP instead.

faq.question: Does converting JPG to PNG add transparency?
faq.answer: No. JPG has no alpha channel, so the PNG output is fully opaque with no transparent pixels. To make parts of an image transparent you'd need a background remover tool first.

faq.question: What's the maximum image size this tool can handle?
faq.answer: It depends on your device's available memory, since conversion happens in your browser rather than on a server. Very large images (tens of megapixels) may slow down or fail on low-memory devices, but typical photos convert in a second or two.

faq.question: Can I convert multiple JPG files to PNG at once?
faq.answer: Yes, you can select or drag in several JPG or HEIC files and each one is converted and downloaded as its own PNG.

howTo.name: Téléchargez le résultat
howTo.text: Téléchargez instantanément votre PDF fusionné.

faq.question: Mes données PDF sont-elles privées ?
faq.answer: Complètement. La fusion se fait localement à l'aide de pdf-lib — aucun fichier n'est jamais envoyé à un serveur.

faq.question: Y a-t-il une limite de pages ou de taille de fichier ?
faq.answer: Aucune limite artificielle — la performance dépend uniquement de la mémoire de votre appareil.

faq.question: Puis-je réorganiser les pages avant la fusion ?
faq.answer: Oui, vous pouvez glisser-déposer les fichiers pour contrôler l'ordre final des pages.

faq.question: Can I merge password-protected PDFs?
faq.answer: No. Encrypted or password-protected PDFs can't currently be opened by the merge tool since decryption isn't supported. Remove the password using the file's original application first, then merge.

faq.question: What happens if one of my PDFs is corrupted?
faq.answer: If a file can't be parsed, the tool will show an error for that specific file rather than silently skipping it. Try opening and re-saving the corrupted file in another PDF viewer before merging.

faq.question: Will merging preserve bookmarks, forms, and links?
faq.answer: Page content, images, and text are preserved, but interactive elements like form fields, bookmarks, and internal links from the source files may not carry over into the merged output.

faq.question: What is the merged file named?
faq.answer: The combined PDF downloads as merged.pdf by default. You can rename it after download like any other file on your device.

faq.question: Puis-je convertir du JSON en CSV ?
faq.answer: Oui, utilisez l'export CSV intégré pour les tableaux JSON plats ou imbriqués.

faq.question: Que se passe-t-il si mon JSON est invalide ?
faq.answer: L'éditeur met en évidence en temps réel la ligne et le caractère exacts de l'erreur de syntaxe.

faq.question: Does the tree view let me collapse and expand nested objects?
faq.answer: Yes, click the arrow next to any object or array to collapse or expand that branch of the tree.

faq.question: Can it sort object keys alphabetically?
faq.answer: No, keys are displayed in the same order they appear in your original JSON — there's no alphabetical sort option.

faq.question: Does it support JSON with comments or trailing commas?
faq.answer: No, this follows strict JSON syntax — comments and trailing commas (sometimes allowed in JSON5 or JSONC) will cause a parse error.

faq.question: What's the difference between beautify and minify here?
faq.answer: Beautify adds indentation and line breaks for readability; minify strips all unnecessary whitespace to produce the smallest possible output — both represent the same underlying data.

howTo.text: Consultez votre taux équivalent horaire, journalier, hebdomadaire et mensuel.

faq.question: Comment le taux horaire est-il calculé à partir du salaire ?
faq.answer: Le salaire annuel est divisé par (heures par semaine × semaines par an) pour déterminer le taux horaire équivalent.

faq.question: Cela prend-il en compte les impôts ?
faq.answer: Non, cela calcule uniquement le salaire brut. Consultez un professionnel fiscal pour des estimations de revenu net.

faq.question: Puis-je personnaliser les heures de travail ?
faq.answer: Oui, vous pouvez ajuster les heures par semaine et les semaines payées par an selon votre horaire.

faq.question: How do you calculate daily and weekly rates?
faq.answer: Daily rate is your hourly rate multiplied by hours worked per day (derived from hours per week ÷ 5); weekly rate is hourly rate times hours per week.

faq.question: What if I work part-time?
faq.answer: Adjust the hours per week field to your actual schedule — the calculator recalculates all rates from that number.

faq.question: Does this account for overtime pay?
faq.answer: No, it assumes a flat rate across all hours entered. For overtime-adjusted pay, calculate regular and overtime hours separately.

faq.question: Why does monthly pay not equal weekly pay times 4?
faq.answer: Monthly pay is annual salary divided by 12, not weekly pay times 4, since most months have slightly more than 4 weeks.

faq.question: Pourquoi dois-je convertir HEIC en JPG ?
faq.answer: HEIC est le format photo par défaut d'Apple, mais de nombreux sites web, applications et programmes Windows ne le prennent pas en charge. JPG fonctionne partout.

faq.question: Mes photos sont-elles envoyées quelque part ?
faq.answer: Non. La conversion se fait localement dans votre navigateur — vos photos ne quittent jamais votre appareil.

faq.question: Cela fonctionne-t-il avec les photos de n'importe quel iPhone ?
faq.answer: Oui, toute image HEIC ou HEIF exportée depuis un iPhone ou un iPad est prise en charge, sous réserve de la prise en charge du décodage d'image de votre navigateur.

faq.question: Vais-je perdre en qualité photo ?
faq.answer: Vous contrôlez la qualité JPG avec un curseur, afin d'équilibrer la taille du fichier et la qualité visuelle.

faq.question: What's the difference between HEIC and HEIF?
faq.answer: HEIC is Apple's specific implementation of the HEIF (High Efficiency Image Format) container — the terms are often used interchangeably, and this tool accepts both file extensions.

faq.question: Does the converted JPG include the original photo's orientation?
faq.answer: The conversion process doesn't read or transfer EXIF orientation data, so double-check the output — if your photo appears rotated, you may need to rotate it manually afterward.

faq.question: Can I convert Live Photos from my iPhone?
faq.answer: Only the still HEIC image is converted — the paired video portion of a Live Photo isn't processed or included.

faq.question: Why does my browser show a blank preview for HEIC files before converting?
faq.answer: Most desktop browsers can't natively render HEIC images in an `` tag, so you may see a blank or broken thumbnail until the file is actually converted.

faq.question: De combien puis-je réduire la taille de mon image ?
faq.answer: Les économies typiques varient de 30% à 80% selon l'image d'origine et le réglage de qualité choisi.

faq.question: La compression réduira-t-elle la qualité de l'image ?
faq.answer: Une certaine perte de qualité est attendue avec la compression avec perte, mais à 70-85% de qualité, la différence est généralement imperceptible.

faq.question: Mes images sont-elles envoyées sur un serveur ?
faq.answer: Non, tout se fait localement à l'aide de l'API Canvas — vos fichiers ne quittent jamais votre appareil.

faq.question: What compression method does this tool use?
faq.answer: It re-encodes your image using your browser's built-in canvas image encoder at an adjustable quality level — no external compression library is used.

faq.question: Should I compress a PNG or a JPG for smaller file size?
faq.answer: JPG compression is lossy and generally shrinks photos much more than PNG, which is lossless — for photos, converting to JPG first typically saves more space than compressing a PNG.

faq.question: Does compressing an image multiple times keep degrading it?
faq.answer: Yes, since JPG compression is lossy, re-compressing an already-compressed JPG repeatedly will introduce additional quality loss each time.

faq.question: What's a good quality setting to use?
faq.answer: 70-85% is a common sweet spot that noticeably reduces file size while keeping visible quality loss minimal — lower it further if file size matters more than appearance.

faq.question: Le redimensionnement va-t-il déformer mon image ?
faq.answer: Activez le verrouillage du rapport d'aspect pour éviter l'étirement, ou désactivez-le pour des dimensions personnalisées exactes.

faq.question: Quels formats d'image sont pris en charge ?
faq.answer: JPG, PNG et la plupart des autres formats d'image courants pris en charge par les navigateurs.

faq.question: What happens if I only set a width or only a height?
faq.answer: With "Lock aspect ratio" enabled, changing one dimension automatically recalculates the other to preserve the original proportions — with it unchecked, only the dimension you change is updated.

faq.question: Can I resize an image to be larger than the original?
faq.answer: Yes, there's no upper limit — you can enter dimensions larger than the source image, though upscaling beyond the original resolution can make the result look soft or pixelated.

faq.question: Does resizing change the file format?
faq.answer: No, the output keeps the same format as your source image — resizing only changes the pixel dimensions.

faq.question: Can I resize to a specific file size instead of pixel dimensions?
faq.answer: No, this tool only resizes by pixel dimensions or percentage — for a specific file size target, use the Image Compressor afterward.

faq.question: Pourquoi convertir des images en WebP ?
faq.answer: WebP produit généralement des fichiers 25 à 35% plus petits que JPG ou PNG à qualité visuelle similaire, améliorant la vitesse de chargement des pages.

faq.question: WebP est-il pris en charge par tous les navigateurs ?
faq.answer: Oui, tous les navigateurs modernes (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge) prennent entièrement en charge les images WebP.

faq.question: Cet outil envoie-t-il mes images quelque part ?
faq.answer: Non, la conversion se fait localement à l'aide d'un Web Worker — vos images ne quittent jamais votre appareil.

faq.question: Does this tool support animated GIFs?
faq.answer: GIF files are accepted, but only a single frame is converted — animation isn't preserved in the WebP output.

faq.question: How much smaller are WebP files compared to JPG or PNG?
faq.answer: WebP typically produces files 25-35% smaller than an equivalent-quality JPG and can be significantly smaller than PNG for photographic content, though exact savings vary by image.

faq.question: Can I control the WebP compression quality?
faq.answer: Yes, a quality slider lets you balance file size against visual quality before converting.

faq.question: Does WebP support transparency like PNG?
faq.answer: Yes, WebP supports an alpha channel, and transparency from a PNG source is preserved in the WebP output.

faq.question: Qu'advient-il de la transparence lors de la conversion de PNG en JPG ?
faq.answer: JPG ne prend pas en charge la transparence, donc les zones transparentes sont remplies de blanc pendant la conversion.

faq.question: Pourquoi convertir PNG en JPG ?
faq.answer: Les fichiers JPG sont généralement beaucoup plus petits que PNG pour les images photographiques, économisant stockage et bande passante.

faq.question: Cette conversion est-elle privée ?
faq.answer: Oui, tout se fait localement dans votre navigateur — aucun fichier n'est jamais envoyé.

faq.question: What color fills in where my PNG was transparent?
faq.answer: Since JPG has no transparency support, transparent and semi-transparent pixels are flattened onto a solid background, typically white, before the JPG is saved. If you need to choose a different background color, check whether the tool exposes that option before converting.

faq.question: Will text or line art in my PNG look blurry as a JPG?
faq.answer: It can. JPG's compression is tuned for photographic gradients, and it tends to introduce soft artifacts around sharp edges like text or hard-edged graphics. For crisp graphics, PNG or WebP usually holds up better.

faq.question: Does converting to JPG remove the color profile from my PNG?
faq.answer: The conversion re-encodes pixel data through the canvas, which normalizes color to standard sRGB. If your PNG carried a wide-gamut or custom ICC profile, that specific profile isn't preserved in the JPG output.

faq.question: Why is my converted JPG file bigger than expected?
faq.answer: The quality slider defaults to 90%, which favors visual fidelity over file size. Lower the quality setting for a smaller file, or run the result through the image compressor for further savings.

faq.question: Le PNG sera-t-il flou si mon SVG n'a pas de taille fixe ?
faq.answer: Non — cet outil restitue toujours le SVG à la largeur exacte que vous choisissez, donc les SVG d'icônes sans attributs de largeur/hauteur restent nets au lieu d'être agrandis et flous.

faq.question: La transparence est-elle préservée ?
faq.answer: Oui, PNG prend en charge la transparence, donc les zones transparentes de votre SVG restent transparentes dans le résultat.

faq.question: Cette conversion est-elle privée ?
faq.answer: Oui, tout se fait localement dans votre navigateur — aucun fichier n'est jamais envoyé.

faq.question: What size PNG do I get if my SVG doesn't specify dimensions?
faq.answer: The tool falls back to a default rendering size or the SVG's viewBox proportions. To guarantee a specific output size, set the width and height fields in the tool before converting rather than relying on the SVG's own metadata.

faq.question: Can I export at a specific pixel size like 512x512 for an app icon?
faq.answer: Yes, you can specify exact output dimensions before converting, and the SVG is rendered fresh at that resolution rather than scaled up from a smaller raster, so edges stay sharp.

faq.question: Does the PNG preserve gradients and filters from my SVG?
faq.answer: Most standard SVG gradients, opacity, and common filter effects render correctly since the browser's native SVG rendering engine handles them. Highly complex or non-standard filter chains may render slightly differently than in a dedicated vector editor.

faq.question: Why does text in my SVG look different after converting to PNG?
faq.answer: If the SVG references a font that isn't installed on your device or embedded in the file, your browser substitutes a fallback font when rendering. Embedding the font or converting text to outlines in your SVG source avoids this.

faq.answer: JPG ne prend pas en charge la transparence, donc les parties transparentes de votre SVG sont remplies de blanc.

faq.question: Le JPG sera-t-il flou si mon SVG n'a pas de taille fixe ?
faq.answer: Non — cet outil restitue toujours le SVG à la largeur exacte que vous choisissez, donc les SVG d'icônes sans attributs de largeur/hauteur restent nets au lieu d'être agrandis et flous.

faq.question: Cette conversion est-elle privée ?

faq.question: Why would I choose JPG output instead of PNG for an SVG?
faq.answer: JPG makes sense when your SVG has no transparency and you want a smaller file, such as for a photo-like illustration or a background graphic. For icons, logos, or anything with transparent areas, PNG is usually the better choice.

faq.question: What background color does my SVG get if it has transparent regions?
faq.answer: Transparent areas are filled with a solid background, typically white, since JPG cannot store an alpha channel. Check the tool for a background color option if you need something other than white.

faq.question: Can I set the output resolution before converting?
faq.answer: Yes, specifying width and height renders the SVG fresh at that pixel size rather than upscaling a smaller image, which keeps curves and text smooth.

faq.question: Will fine details in my SVG survive JPG compression?
faq.answer: Thin lines and small text can soften slightly due to JPG's lossy compression, especially at lower quality settings. If your SVG is mostly line art or text, PNG will preserve it more crisply.

faq.question: Why convert SVG to WebP instead of PNG?
faq.answer: WebP typically produces a noticeably smaller file than PNG at similar visual quality while still supporting full transparency, making it a good choice for web use when you don't need a vector format.

faq.question: Does WebP output keep my SVG's transparent background?
faq.answer: Yes, WebP supports an alpha channel just like PNG, so transparent and semi-transparent areas in your SVG are preserved rather than filled in.

faq.question: Does this use lossless or lossy WebP compression?
faq.answer: It uses lossy WebP compression with an adjustable quality slider — higher quality preserves more detail at a larger file size, but there's no dedicated lossless mode.

faq.question: What resolution should I render my SVG at for icons?
faq.answer: For UI icons, render at the exact pixel size you'll display them (such as 24x24 or 48x48) or at 2x that size for high-DPI screens, since WebP is a raster format and won't scale further without quality loss.

faq.question: Will I lose transparency converting PNG to WebP?
faq.answer: No, WebP supports transparency, so any transparent areas in your PNG are preserved in the output.

faq.question: How much smaller will my WebP file be than the original PNG?
faq.answer: This varies by image content, but WebP often produces noticeably smaller files than PNG, especially for photographic or gradient-heavy images.

faq.question: Should I use lossless or lossy WebP for icons and logos?
faq.answer: This tool only offers lossy WebP encoding with an adjustable quality slider — there's no dedicated lossless mode, so use a high quality setting for sharp-edged graphics like icons and logos.

faq.question: Is WebP a safe format to use for a website today?
faq.answer: Yes, WebP is supported by all current major browsers and has been for several years, making it safe for general web use.

faq.question: La transparence est-elle préservée ?

faq.question: Cette conversion est-elle privée ?

faq.question: Does converting an animated WebP to PNG keep the animation?
faq.answer: No, PNG doesn't support animation, so only a single static frame is produced from an animated WebP source.

faq.question: Why convert WebP back to PNG if WebP is smaller?
faq.answer: PNG has broader compatibility with older software and design tools that don't support WebP, and it's lossless, which matters for images you plan to edit further.

faq.question: Does the PNG lose any quality compared to the WebP source?
faq.answer: If the source WebP was lossy, that quality loss is already baked in — converting to PNG won't restore detail, but it won't lose any further quality since PNG encoding itself is lossless.

faq.question: Will the PNG file be much larger than the WebP?
faq.answer: Usually yes — PNG's lossless compression generally produces larger files than WebP for the same image, especially for photos.

faq.question: Why would I need to convert WebP to JPG?
faq.answer: JPG has near-universal compatibility with older tools, printers, and platforms that may not fully support WebP.

faq.question: Does converting to JPG fill transparent WebP areas with a color?
faq.answer: Yes, since JPG doesn't support transparency, any transparent regions are typically filled with a solid background (usually white) during conversion.

faq.question: Will converting WebP to JPG reduce image quality further?
faq.answer: Yes, JPG re-encoding is lossy, so converting an already-lossy WebP to JPG adds another round of compression artifacts on top of the original.

faq.question: L'encodage augmente-t-il la taille du fichier ?
faq.answer: Oui, l'encodage Base64 augmente la taille d'environ 33% par rapport au fichier binaire d'origine.

faq.question: Mon image est-elle envoyée quelque part ?
faq.answer: Non, l'encodage et le décodage se font tous deux localement dans votre navigateur à l'aide de l'API FileReader.

faq.question: How much bigger does a Base64-encoded image get?
faq.answer: Roughly 33% larger than the original binary file, since Base64 encodes every 3 bytes as 4 characters.

faq.question: What's the difference between the raw Base64 string and a data URL?
faq.answer: A data URL wraps the Base64 string with a `data:image/png;base64,` prefix that tells a browser how to interpret it directly — the raw string alone is just the encoded bytes.

faq.question: Can I decode a Base64 string back into a downloadable image file?
faq.answer: Yes, switch to the decode tab, paste your Base64 string or data URL, and download the resulting image file directly.

faq.question: Why would I embed an image as Base64 instead of linking to a file?
faq.answer: Embedding avoids a separate network request, which is useful for small icons in CSS/HTML or inline email images, though it increases the size of the containing file.

faq.answer: Oui, les codes QR générés sont libres d'utilisation pour tout usage personnel ou commercial.

faq.question: Quelle est la quantité maximale de texte que je peux encoder ?
faq.answer: Les codes QR peuvent contenir jusqu'à quelques milliers de caractères, bien qu'un contenu plus court se scanne plus fiablement.

faq.question: Mes données sont-elles envoyées à un serveur pour générer le code ?
faq.answer: Non, l'image du code QR est entièrement rendue dans votre navigateur — rien n'est transmis nulle part.

faq.question: What error correction level does the QR code use?
faq.answer: A fixed medium (M) error correction level is used, which balances scan reliability with a reasonably compact code pattern.

faq.question: Can I change the QR code's color or add a logo?

faq.question: Why won't my QR code scan?

faq.question: Why does the picked color look slightly different from what I expected?

faq.question: Can I split an encrypted or password-protected PDF?
faq.answer: No, password-protected PDFs cannot currently be opened by the tool. Remove the password in the original application before splitting.

faq.question: What are the split files named?
faq.answer: Individual pages are named using the original filename with the page number appended, such as document_page-1.pdf, making it easy to identify each page after extraction.

faq.question: Does splitting reduce the quality of my pages?
faq.answer: No. Splitting only separates existing pages into new PDF files without re-rendering or recompressing content, so text, images, and quality remain exactly as in the source file.

faq.question: Dans quel format d'image les pages sont-elles exportées ?
faq.answer: Chaque page est exportée sous forme d'image PNG haute résolution.

faq.question: Cela fonctionne-t-il avec des PDF scannés ?
faq.answer: Oui, toute page PDF — textuelle ou scannée — est rendue visuellement telle qu'elle apparaît.

faq.question: Mon document est-il envoyé quelque part ?
faq.answer: Non, le rendu se fait entièrement dans votre navigateur à l'aide de la bibliothèque pdf.js — rien n'est envoyé.

faq.question: What resolution are the exported images?
faq.answer: Pages are rendered at a high scale factor for sharp output, well above standard screen resolution, so text and fine details stay legible even when zoomed in.

faq.question: Can I export as JPG instead of PNG?
faq.answer: Currently pages are exported as PNG only, which preserves sharp text and lines without lossy compression artifacts. There's no JPG output option at this time.

faq.question: How are multiple pages downloaded?
faq.answer: For a multi-page PDF, all rendered page images are bundled into a single ZIP file rather than downloading one by one.

faq.question: Will very large or high-page-count PDFs slow down my browser?
faq.answer: Rendering happens page by page in your browser, so PDFs with hundreds of pages or very large embedded images can take noticeably longer and use more memory than a short document.

faq.question: Puis-je combiner des images JPG et PNG dans un même PDF ?
faq.answer: Oui, vous pouvez mélanger librement les fichiers JPG et PNG — chacun est intégré à sa résolution native.

faq.question: Puis-je réorganiser les images avant de créer le PDF ?
faq.answer: Oui, glissez-déposez les miniatures pour définir l'ordre exact des pages.

faq.question: Y a-t-il une limite au nombre d'images que je peux ajouter ?
faq.answer: Aucune limite artificielle — la performance dépend uniquement de la mémoire disponible sur votre appareil.

faq.question: Does each image become its own page?
faq.answer: Yes. Every image you add is placed on its own page in the resulting PDF, in the order you arrange them.

faq.question: What page size and orientation does the PDF use?
faq.answer: Each page is sized to match its source image's dimensions and orientation, so a mix of portrait and landscape photos will produce a PDF with differently sized pages rather than being forced onto a uniform page size.

faq.question: Will my images be recompressed or lose quality?
faq.answer: Images are embedded into the PDF at their original resolution and quality without additional recompression, so the output can be large if your source photos are high-resolution.

faq.question: Can I use HEIC or WebP images?
faq.answer: No, only JPG and PNG files are currently supported. Convert HEIC or WebP images to JPG or PNG first, for example with this site's image converter tools.

faq.question: Cela fait-il pivoter chaque page ou une seule ?
faq.answer: Chaque page du document est pivotée selon le même angle que vous sélectionnez.

faq.question: La rotation affectera-t-elle le texte ou la qualité du PDF ?
faq.answer: Non, la rotation ne change que les métadonnées d'orientation d'affichage de chaque page — le contenu et la qualité sont préservés.

faq.question: Mon fichier est-il envoyé sur un serveur ?
faq.answer: Non, la rotation se fait entièrement localement à l'aide de pdf-lib.

faq.question: Can I rotate individual pages differently?
faq.answer: Yes, each page can be rotated independently in the visual grid — "Rotate all" and "Rotate selected" buttons are just shortcuts for applying rotation to many pages at once.

faq.question: Does rotating change the file size significantly?
faq.answer: Rotation itself just updates each page's orientation value, but the file is rebuilt and re-saved in the process, so the output size can shift slightly from the original — usually not significantly.

faq.question: Can I rotate a password-protected PDF?
faq.answer: No, encrypted PDFs can't currently be opened by the tool. You'll need to remove the password first using the file's original application.

faq.question: What is the rotated file named when downloaded?
faq.answer: The output keeps a name based on your original file, such as document_rotated.pdf, so you can tell it apart from the source.

faq.question: Puis-je supprimer plusieurs pages non consécutives ?
faq.answer: Oui, utilisez une liste séparée par des virgules et des plages, comme « 2, 4-6, 9 ».

faq.question: Puis-je supprimer toutes les pages ?
faq.answer: Non, au moins une page doit rester dans le document final.

faq.question: Mon PDF est-il envoyé quelque part ?
faq.answer: Non, toutes les modifications se font entièrement localement à l'aide de pdf-lib dans votre navigateur.

faq.question: How do I specify which pages to delete?
faq.answer: You can enter individual page numbers, comma-separated lists, or ranges like 2-5, and combine them, for example 1,3,7-9, to remove several pages in one pass.

faq.question: Can I delete pages from an encrypted PDF?
faq.answer: No, password-protected PDFs can't currently be opened by the tool since decryption isn't supported.

faq.question: Does deleting pages affect the quality of the remaining pages?
faq.answer: No. The remaining pages are copied over unchanged; only the specified pages are removed, so there's no re-rendering or recompression of the pages you keep.

faq.question: What happens if I enter an invalid page number?
faq.answer: If you specify a page number outside the document's range, the tool will flag it as invalid rather than silently ignoring it, so you can correct the input before deleting.

faq.question: De combien mon PDF sera-t-il plus petit ?
faq.answer: Les économies varient beaucoup — généralement de 5 à 20% grâce à l'optimisation des métadonnées et de la structure, car la véritable recompression d'images nécessite un serveur ou un codec lourd.

faq.question: La compression affectera-t-elle la qualité ou le contenu ?
faq.answer: Non, il s'agit d'une optimisation sans perte — tout le texte, les images et la mise en forme restent inchangés.

faq.question: Pourquoi la compression n'est-elle pas aussi agressive que certains outils de bureau ?
faq.answer: Le traitement uniquement dans le navigateur ne peut pas réencoder les images intégrées avec un codec d'image lourd sans une taille de téléchargement importante, donc les gains sont plus modestes que les outils côté serveur.

faq.question: Can I compress a password-protected PDF?
faq.answer: No, encrypted PDFs can't currently be opened by the compressor. Remove the password in the original application first.

faq.question: Why does compressing a scanned PDF barely reduce its size?
faq.answer: Scanned PDFs are usually made of one large image per page that's already compressed by the scanner, so this tool's lossless optimization of PDF structure and embedded fonts has little left to trim compared with text-based PDFs.

faq.question: Does compression remove any content from my PDF?
faq.answer: No. Compression optimizes the internal PDF structure, such as removing duplicate objects and streamlining fonts, without deleting pages, text, or images.

faq.question: What is the compressed file named?
faq.answer: The output downloads with a suffix added to your original filename, such as document_compressed.pdf, so you can distinguish it from the source file.

faq.answer: Le temps de lecture est estimé à l'aide d'une vitesse de lecture moyenne de 200 mots par minute.

faq.question: Cet outil stocke-t-il ou envoie-t-il mon texte quelque part ?
faq.answer: Non, tout le comptage se fait localement dans votre navigateur pendant que vous tapez — rien n'est transmis.

faq.question: Comment les phrases et les paragraphes sont-ils comptés ?
faq.answer: Les phrases sont détectées par la ponctuation terminale (. ! ?) et les paragraphes par les sauts de ligne.

faq.question: Does the counter support languages without spaces, like Chinese or Japanese?
faq.answer: Word counting relies on spaces and punctuation to separate words, so it's designed for space-delimited languages; character count remains accurate for any language, but word count may be less meaningful for languages like Chinese or Japanese.

faq.question: Is there a limit to how much text I can paste in?
faq.answer: There's no hard cap enforced by the tool, but since counting runs live in your browser as you type, extremely large documents (tens of thousands of words) may make updates feel less instant.

faq.question: Does the character count include spaces?
faq.answer: The tool shows both character count with spaces and without, so you can see either figure depending on what you need, such as matching a strict character limit for a form or platform.

faq.question: Can I count words in a specific selection instead of the whole text?
faq.answer: No, the counter currently tallies the entire contents of the text box rather than a highlighted selection. Paste only the portion you want counted if you need a partial count.

faq.question: À quoi sert l'encodage Base64 ?
faq.answer: Base64 encode des données binaires ou textuelles en caractères ASCII, couramment utilisé pour intégrer des données dans des URL, du JSON ou des e-mails.

faq.question: Mon texte est-il envoyé à un serveur ?
faq.answer: Non, l'encodage et le décodage se font tous deux localement à l'aide des fonctions btoa/atob intégrées de votre navigateur.

faq.question: Cela prend-il en charge le texte Unicode ?
faq.answer: Oui, les caractères non-ASCII comme les emojis et les lettres accentuées sont correctement pris en charge.

faq.question: Can I encode or decode files, not just text?
faq.answer: No, this tool works on typed or pasted text only — for encoding image files to Base64, use the dedicated Base64 Image Encoder tool instead.

faq.question: Why does decoding sometimes fail with an error?
faq.answer: Decoding fails if the input isn't valid Base64 — for example, it contains characters outside the Base64 alphabet or has incorrect padding.

faq.question: Does this support URL-safe Base64?
faq.answer: No, it uses standard Base64 encoding — URL-safe Base64 (which swaps `+`/`/` for `-`/`_`) isn't a separate mode here.

faq.question: Why does encoded text look longer than the original?
faq.answer: Base64 encodes every 3 bytes of input as 4 characters of output, so encoded text is roughly 33% larger than the original.

faq.question: Quand ai-je besoin de l'encodage d'URL ?
faq.answer: L'encodage d'URL est nécessaire lorsque des caractères spéciaux (espaces, &, =, ?) apparaissent dans les paramètres de requête ou les segments de chemin.

faq.question: Quel standard d'encodage cela utilise-t-il ?
faq.answer: Ceci utilise les fonctions natives encodeURIComponent/decodeURIComponent du navigateur (encodage en pourcentage RFC 3986).

faq.question: Mes données sont-elles envoyées quelque part ?
faq.answer: Non, tout l'encodage et le décodage se font localement dans votre navigateur.

faq.question: What's the difference between encodeURIComponent and encodeURI?
faq.answer: This tool uses encodeURIComponent-style encoding, which escapes a wider set of characters (including `&`, `=`, `/`) — suitable for encoding individual query parameter values rather than a full URL.

faq.question: How are spaces encoded?
faq.answer: Spaces are encoded as %20, matching standard percent-encoding rather than the `+` convention used in HTML form submissions.

faq.question: Can I encode an entire URL including the query string?
faq.answer: You can encode any text you paste in, but encoding a full URL this way will also escape characters like `:` and `/` that you likely want to keep — it's built for encoding individual values, not whole URLs.

faq.question: Why does decoding fail on my input?
faq.answer: Decoding fails if the text contains a `%` not followed by two valid hex digits, which happens with malformed or already-partially-decoded input.

jwt-decoder.seoTitle: Décodeur JWT en Ligne – Gratuit et Instantané, Sans Inscription
jwt-decoder.metaDescription: Décodez des JSON Web Tokens (JWT) instantanément dans votre navigateur. Consultez l'en-tête, la charge utile et l'expiration — aucune vérification de signature, aucun appel serveur.

howTo.name: Décodage automatique
howTo.text: L'en-tête et la charge utile sont décodés depuis Base64URL et affichés sous forme de JSON formaté.

howTo.name: Vérifiez l'expiration
howTo.text: Si une revendication exp est présente, son statut d'expiration est mis en évidence.

faq.question: Cet outil vérifie-t-il la signature du JWT ?
faq.answer: Non, cet outil décode uniquement l'en-tête et la charge utile — il ne vérifie pas la signature. Ne faites jamais confiance à un jeton décodé sans vérification côté serveur.

faq.question: Mon jeton est-il envoyé à un serveur ?
faq.answer: Non, le décodage se fait entièrement localement dans votre navigateur à l'aide du décodage Base64URL.

faq.question: Que signifie la revendication exp ?
faq.answer: La revendication exp est un horodatage Unix indiquant quand le jeton expire. Cet outil met en évidence s'il a déjà expiré.

faq.question: Can I use this to check if a token is expired?
faq.answer: You can inspect the exp claim after decoding to see if the timestamp is in the past, but the tool doesn't automatically validate expiry against the current time for you.

faq.question: What algorithm does the header show?
faq.answer: The decoded header includes the alg field, such as HS256 or RS256, indicating what algorithm the token was signed with — this is metadata only and isn't used to verify anything here.

faq.question: Can I decode a malformed or truncated JWT?
faq.answer: No, the token must have three dot-separated Base64URL segments (header, payload, signature); if a segment is missing or not valid Base64URL, decoding will fail.

faq.question: Are custom claims in the payload displayed?
faq.answer: Yes, all claims in the payload are shown, both registered claims like iss and sub and any custom claims your application added.

faq.question: Quelle version d'UUID est générée ?
faq.answer: Cet outil génère des UUID version 4 (aléatoires) à l'aide de l'API native crypto.randomUUID du navigateur.

faq.question: Les UUID sont-ils cryptographiquement aléatoires ?
faq.answer: Oui, ils sont générés à l'aide du générateur de nombres aléatoires cryptographiquement sécurisé de l'API Web Crypto.

faq.question: Combien puis-je en générer à la fois ?
faq.answer: Jusqu'à 500 UUID par lot, avec prise en charge instantanée de la copie de tout.

faq.question: Can I generate UUIDs in a specific format, like uppercase or without hyphens?
faq.answer: Yes, you can toggle uppercase letters and choose whether hyphens are included in the output.

faq.question: Are the generated UUIDs guaranteed to be unique?
faq.answer: UUID v4 relies on 122 random bits, making collisions astronomically unlikely in practice, though no random generator can offer a mathematical uniqueness guarantee.

faq.question: Can I copy all generated UUIDs at once?
faq.answer: Yes, there's a copy-all option that puts every generated UUID on the clipboard as a newline-separated list.

faq.question: Why do all UUIDs start with a similar pattern?
faq.answer: UUID v4 always has a fixed '4' in the version position and one of a few fixed bits in the variant position, so every UUID shares that structural pattern even though the rest is random.

faq.question: Pourquoi MD5 n'est-il pas proposé ?
faq.answer: MD5 n'est pas disponible dans l'API Web Crypto native du navigateur et est cryptographiquement compromis — utilisez SHA-256 ou SHA-512 à la place.

faq.question: Mon fichier est-il envoyé sur un serveur ?
faq.answer: Non, le hachage se fait entièrement localement à l'aide de la fonction SubtleCrypto.digest de l'API Web Crypto.

faq.question: À quoi sert un hash ?
faq.answer: Les hashs sont utilisés pour vérifier l'intégrité des fichiers, détecter les doublons et créer des empreintes de longueur fixe des données.

faq.question: Which hashing algorithms are available?
faq.answer: SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, and SHA-512 are supported, all computed via the browser's built-in Web Crypto API.

faq.question: Can I hash a file instead of typed text?
faq.answer: Yes, you can upload a file and the tool computes its hash directly from the file bytes, which is useful for verifying download integrity against a published checksum.

faq.question: Why do two slightly different inputs produce completely different hashes?
faq.answer: This is the avalanche effect — cryptographic hash functions are designed so that even a one-character change produces a wholly different, unpredictable output.

faq.question: Can I use SHA-1 for security purposes?
faq.answer: SHA-1 is available for compatibility with legacy checksums, but it's considered cryptographically broken for security use; SHA-256 or higher is recommended for anything security-sensitive.

faq.question: Can I test replacement strings, not just matches?

faq.question: Can I write raw HTML inside my Markdown?

faq.question: What happens if rows have a different number of columns?
faq.answer: Rows with fewer columns than the header will have missing fields in the resulting JSON objects, and extra columns beyond the header may be dropped or misaligned.

faq.question: Are numbers and booleans converted to their proper JSON types?
faq.answer: Check the output carefully — CSV values are text by nature, and whether numeric-looking strings are converted to JSON numbers depends on the parser's type inference, not a setting you control.

percentage-calculator.metaDescription: Calculez X% de Y, quel pourcentage X représente de Y, ou le changement en pourcentage entre deux nombres, instantanément. Gratuit, précis et privé.

faq.question: Comment calculer X% de Y ?
faq.answer: Multipliez Y par (X divisé par 100). Par exemple, 20% de 150 est 150 × 0,20 = 30.

faq.question: Comment le changement en pourcentage est-il calculé ?
faq.answer: Le changement en pourcentage est ((nouvelle valeur − ancienne valeur) / |ancienne valeur|) × 100.

faq.question: Le changement en pourcentage peut-il être négatif ?
faq.answer: Oui, un résultat négatif indique une diminution par rapport à la valeur d'origine.

faq.question: What's the difference between 'percentage of' and 'percentage change'?
faq.answer: Percentage of finds a portion of a value (e.g. 20% of 50); percentage change measures how much a value increased or decreased between two numbers.

faq.question: How do I find what percentage one number is of another?
faq.answer: Use the 'X is what % of Y' mode — enter both numbers and the calculator divides and converts to a percentage automatically.

faq.question: Can I calculate percentages greater than 100%?
faq.answer: Yes, there's no upper limit — useful for growth rates or markups that exceed the original value.

faq.question: Does rounding affect the result?
faq.answer: Results are shown to two decimal places for readability, but the underlying calculation uses full precision.

howTo.text: Consultez le montant économisé et le prix final mis à jour en direct.

faq.question: Comment le prix réduit est-il calculé ?
faq.answer: Prix final = prix d'origine − (prix d'origine × pourcentage de remise / 100).

faq.question: Puis-je calculer des remises cumulées ?
faq.answer: Cet outil calcule une seule remise ; pour des remises cumulées, appliquez le prix final comme le prochain prix d'origine.

faq.question: Cela inclut-il la taxe de vente ?
faq.answer: Non, cela calcule uniquement la remise. Utilisez la Calculatrice de Taxe de Vente pour la taxe sur le prix réduit.

faq.question: How do stacked discounts work?
faq.answer: Each discount is applied sequentially to the reduced price from the previous step, not added together — two 10% discounts equal roughly 19% off, not 20%.

faq.question: What's the difference between markup and discount?
faq.answer: A discount reduces a price by a percentage; a markup increases a cost by a percentage to set a selling price — this tool only calculates discounts.

faq.question: Can I calculate the original price from a sale price?
faq.answer: This calculator works forward from the original price — to reverse it, divide the sale price by (1 − discount as a decimal).

faq.question: Is the savings amount shown in currency or percentage?
faq.answer: Both — the tool shows the dollar amount saved alongside the final discounted price.

faq.answer: Aux États-Unis, 15-20% est typique pour un bon service au restaurant, bien que cela varie selon la région et le type de service.

faq.question: Comment le montant par personne est-il calculé ?
faq.answer: L'addition plus le pourboire est divisée équitablement par le nombre de personnes saisi.

faq.question: Puis-je utiliser un pourcentage de pourboire personnalisé ?
faq.answer: Oui, saisissez n'importe quel pourcentage directement dans le champ de saisie à côté des préréglages.

faq.question: How do I split a bill unevenly between people?
faq.answer: This calculator splits evenly by default; for uneven splits, calculate each person's portion of the bill separately before entering it.

faq.question: Should I tip on the pre-tax or post-tax amount?
faq.answer: Conventions vary — many guides suggest tipping on the pre-tax subtotal, though tipping on the total is also common and accepted.

faq.question: Why is my per-person total slightly different when I multiply it back?
faq.answer: The per-person amount is rounded to the nearest cent for display, so multiplying it by the number of people can be a cent or two off from the exact total — the tool flags this when it happens.

faq.question: Can I use this for takeout or delivery tipping?
faq.answer: Yes, enter the order total as the bill amount and set whatever tip percentage feels appropriate for the service.

faq.question: Quelle formule est utilisée pour calculer la mensualité ?
faq.answer: Mensualité = [P × r × (1+r)^n] / [(1+r)^n − 1], où P est le principal, r est le taux d'intérêt mensuel et n est le nombre de mois.

faq.question: Cela prend-il en compte les frais ou l'assurance ?
faq.answer: Non, cela calcule uniquement le principal et l'intérêt. Les frais supplémentaires ou l'assurance ne sont pas inclus.

faq.question: Est-ce adapté aux prêts immobiliers et automobiles ?
faq.answer: Oui, la formule standard de prêt amortissable s'applique aussi bien aux prêts immobiliers, aux prêts auto et aux prêts personnels.

faq.question: What does EMI stand for?
faq.answer: Equated Monthly Installment — a fixed payment amount made every month that covers both principal and interest over the loan term.

faq.question: Why does more of my early payments go to interest?
faq.answer: Interest is calculated on the remaining balance each month, which is highest at the start of the loan, so early payments are interest-heavy even though the total payment stays fixed.

faq.question: Can I see a full payment-by-payment breakdown?
faq.answer: Yes, expand the amortization schedule below the results to see principal, interest, and remaining balance for every month of the loan.

faq.question: What happens if I enter a 0% interest rate?
faq.answer: The calculator switches to a simple even split of the loan amount across the number of months, with no interest added.

compound-interest-calculator.metaDescription: Calculez la valeur future d'un investissement avec des intérêts composés, à n'importe quelle fréquence de capitalisation, instantanément. Gratuit et privé.
compound-interest-calculator.subheading: Calculez la valeur future de votre investissement avec des intérêts composés — instantanément et en privé.

howTo.name: Entrez votre principal

howTo.text: Consultez la valeur future et l'intérêt total gagné.

faq.question: Quelle formule cela utilise-t-il ?
faq.answer: A = P(1 + r/n)^(nt), où P est le principal, r est le taux annuel, n est la fréquence de capitalisation et t est la durée en années.

faq.question: Comment la fréquence de capitalisation affecte-t-elle la croissance ?
faq.answer: Une capitalisation plus fréquente (par exemple quotidienne plutôt qu'annuelle) entraîne des rendements légèrement plus élevés pour le même taux nominal.

faq.question: Cela prend-il en compte des contributions supplémentaires ?
faq.answer: Non, cela calcule la croissance à partir d'un seul principal initial sans contributions récurrentes.

faq.question: What's the difference between compounding frequency options?
faq.answer: More frequent compounding (daily vs annually) applies interest to your balance more often, producing slightly higher returns for the same nominal rate over time.

faq.question: Does this include monthly contributions?
faq.answer: No, this calculator models a single initial principal growing on its own — use the Investment Return Calculator for a version that includes monthly contributions.

faq.question: How accurate is the growth chart?
faq.answer: The chart plots the exact compound interest formula at yearly intervals — it's a precise projection assuming a constant rate, not a market forecast.

faq.question: What's a realistic annual rate to use?
faq.answer: This varies widely by investment type — the tool doesn't assume a specific rate, so enter whatever rate matches your actual account or expected return.

faq.question: Comment la taxe de vente est-elle calculée ?
faq.answer: Montant de la taxe = prix × (taux de taxe / 100). Total = prix + montant de la taxe.

faq.question: Comment trouver le prix avant taxe à partir du total d'un reçu ?
faq.answer: Utilisez le mode Total → Prix : prix avant taxe = total / (1 + taux de taxe / 100).

faq.question: Cela inclut-il la taxe locale et d'état combinées ?
faq.answer: Oui, saisissez votre taux de taxe effectif combiné (état + local) pour un total précis.

faq.question: How do I calculate the tax amount alone?
faq.answer: The tool shows the tax amount as a separate line from the pre-tax price and total, so you can see exactly how much tax was added.

faq.question: Can I use this for VAT instead of sales tax?
faq.answer: Yes, the math is identical — enter your VAT rate as the tax percentage and it works the same way.

faq.question: Why do sales tax rates vary by location?
faq.answer: Sales tax is set at the state, county, and sometimes city level in many countries, so combined rates differ by where a purchase is made — enter your local combined rate.

faq.question: Does reverse mode work for any tax rate?
faq.answer: Yes, enter the total (tax-included) amount and the tax rate, and the calculator backs out the original pre-tax price.

bmi-calculator.metaDescription: Calculez votre Indice de Masse Corporelle (IMC) en unités métriques ou impériales, instantanément dans votre navigateur. Gratuit, privé, avec répartition par catégorie.

howTo.text: Consultez votre valeur d'IMC et la catégorie de poids mises à jour en direct.

faq.question: Comment l'IMC est-il calculé ?
faq.answer: Métrique : poids (kg) / taille (m)². Impérial : poids (lb) / taille (in)² × 703.

faq.question: Quelles sont les catégories d'IMC ?
faq.answer: Moins de 18,5 est un poids insuffisant, 18,5–24,9 est un poids sain, 25–29,9 est un surpoids et 30+ est une obésité.

faq.question: L'IMC est-il une mesure de santé parfaite ?
faq.answer: Non, l'IMC ne tient pas compte de la masse musculaire, de la densité osseuse ni de la composition corporelle. Consultez un professionnel de santé pour une évaluation complète.

faq.question: Does BMI differ for men and women?
faq.answer: The BMI formula itself is the same for everyone — it doesn't adjust for sex, which is part of why it's considered a rough screening tool rather than a precise health measure.

faq.question: What's a healthy BMI range?
faq.answer: 18.5 to 24.9 is generally classified as a healthy weight range for adults, though this can vary by individual factors like muscle mass and body frame.

faq.question: Can I switch between metric and imperial units?
faq.answer: Yes, use the unit toggle to switch between centimeters/kilograms and feet-inches/pounds — your BMI recalculates instantly.

faq.question: Is BMI accurate for athletes?
faq.answer: Not always — BMI doesn't distinguish muscle from fat, so muscular individuals can show a higher BMI despite having low body fat.

faq.question: Quels formats de numéro sont disponibles ?
faq.answer: Choisissez parmi des numéros simples (« 1 »), « Page 1 », « 1 sur N » ou le style « - 1 - ».

faq.question: Mon PDF est-il téléversé quelque part ?
faq.answer: Non, les numéros de page sont ajoutés entièrement dans votre navigateur via pdf-lib — votre fichier n'est jamais téléversé sur un serveur.

faq.question: Can I skip numbering on the first page, like a cover page?
faq.answer: No, every page gets a number — there's no option to exclude a specific page like a cover page from numbering. You can set the starting number, but that changes what number the first page displays, not whether it's numbered.

faq.question: Can I add page numbers to an encrypted PDF?
faq.answer: No, password-protected PDFs can't currently be opened by the tool. Remove the password in the original application before adding page numbers.

faq.question: Will page numbers overlap existing content near the page edges?
faq.answer: Page numbers are placed in the margin area you select (such as bottom center or bottom right), but if your document already has content very close to that margin, the added number can visually overlap it.

faq.question: Can I customize the font size or color of the page numbers?
faq.answer: The tool currently applies a standard font size and color for page numbers; there's no option to customize typography, only position, starting number, and number format.

faq.question: Comment la différence est-elle calculée ?
faq.answer: L'outil compare les deux textes ligne par ligne et met en évidence les lignes ajoutées (vert) ou supprimées (rouge).

faq.question: Peut-il comparer du code ou du JSON ?
faq.answer: Oui, il fonctionne avec n'importe quel texte brut, y compris le code, le JSON ou les fichiers de configuration.

faq.question: Mon texte est-il téléversé quelque part ?
faq.answer: Non, la comparaison s'exécute entièrement dans votre navigateur — rien n'est envoyé à un serveur.

faq.question: Can I switch between line-level and word-level diffing?
faq.answer: No, comparison is line-level only — there's no word-level or character-level diff mode.

faq.question: Does it ignore whitespace differences?
faq.answer: No, there's no option to ignore whitespace — differences in spacing or indentation will show up as changes.

faq.question: Can I see the diff as a unified patch?
faq.answer: No, results are shown as a highlighted side-by-side or inline line list, not a unified-diff/patch-style text format.

faq.question: Does it handle very large text blocks?
faq.answer: Yes, but very large inputs (many thousands of lines) may take longer to compute and render, since diffing runs entirely in your browser.

howTo.text: Cliquez sur Recadrer et Télécharger pour enregistrer l'image recadrée au format PNG.

faq.question: Quels formats d'image sont pris en charge ?
faq.answer: Vous pouvez téléverser des fichiers JPG, PNG, WebP et la plupart des formats d'image courants. Le résultat recadré est téléchargé au format PNG.

faq.question: Mon image est-elle téléversée sur un serveur ?
faq.answer: Non, le recadrage se fait entièrement dans votre navigateur via l'API Canvas — votre image ne quitte jamais votre appareil.

faq.question: Puis-je définir une taille de recadrage exacte ?
faq.answer: Oui, utilisez les champs X, Y, Largeur et Hauteur pour saisir des valeurs précises en pixels en complément des poignées de glissement.

faq.question: Can I crop to a specific aspect ratio like 16:9 or 1:1?
faq.answer: Cropping is freeform — drag to select any rectangle, or enter exact X/Y/width/height values. There are no fixed aspect-ratio presets or a ratio lock.

faq.question: Can I rotate the image before cropping?
faq.answer: No, this tool only crops a rectangular region — it doesn't include a rotation control. Rotate the image first with another tool if you need to straighten it.

faq.question: What happens if I crop outside the image boundaries?
faq.answer: The crop selection is typically constrained to stay within the original image dimensions, so you can't select an area beyond the edges of your uploaded photo.

faq.question: Can I enter exact pixel dimensions for the crop area?
faq.answer: Yes, alongside dragging the crop handles, you can type exact X, Y, width, and height values for precise pixel-accurate crops.

faq.question: Comment l'âge est-il calculé ?
faq.answer: Le calculateur compte les années, mois et jours calendaires complets entre les deux dates — pas une simple division en jours.

faq.question: Puis-je calculer l'âge à une date future ou passée ?
faq.answer: Oui, modifiez la date « de référence » pour voir quel était ou sera votre âge à n'importe quelle date.

faq.question: Ma date de naissance est-elle stockée quelque part ?
faq.answer: Non, tous les calculs se font localement dans votre navigateur et rien n'est envoyé à un serveur.

faq.question: Does this account for leap years?
faq.answer: Yes, the calculation uses actual calendar dates, so leap years are automatically factored into total days and the days-until-next-birthday count.

faq.question: Can I calculate someone else's age, not just my own?
faq.answer: Yes, enter any birth date — the tool isn't limited to your own date of birth.

faq.question: What does 'total months' include?
faq.answer: It's your full age converted into a single number of months, combining the years and months shown above it.

faq.question: Why would I calculate age as of a past date?
faq.answer: Useful for figuring out how old someone was at a specific historical event or document date, not just their current age.

faq.question: Quelles unités sont prises en charge ?
faq.answer: Longueur (mm, cm, m, km, in, ft, yd, mi), poids (mg, g, kg, oz, lb) et température (Celsius, Fahrenheit, Kelvin).

faq.question: La température est-elle convertie correctement ?
faq.answer: Oui, la température utilise des formules de conversion appropriées, pas de simples multiplicateurs, car les échelles Celsius, Fahrenheit et Kelvin ne partagent pas de point zéro commun.

faq.question: Puis-je inverser rapidement les unités de départ et d'arrivée ?
faq.answer: Oui, utilisez le bouton d'inversion pour inverser instantanément le sens de la conversion.

faq.question: How precise are the conversions?
faq.answer: Conversions use standard, internationally recognized conversion factors and display results to a practical number of decimal places.

faq.question: Why does temperature conversion work differently from length and weight?
faq.answer: Temperature scales (Celsius, Fahrenheit, Kelvin) have different zero points, so converting requires an offset formula rather than a simple multiplication ratio like length or weight.

faq.question: Can I convert between imperial and metric in both directions?
faq.answer: Yes, every unit works both as a source and target — select any two units and convert either way.

faq.question: Are the length units based on international or US definitions?
faq.answer: Standard international definitions are used (e.g. exactly 2.54 cm per inch), consistent with common engineering and scientific references.

faq.question: Ce générateur de mot de passe est-il sécurisé ?
faq.answer: Oui. Les mots de passe sont générés à l'aide du générateur de nombres aléatoires cryptographiquement sécurisé de votre navigateur (crypto.getRandomValues), et non d'une fonction pseudo-aléatoire plus faible.

faq.question: Mes mots de passe générés sont-ils envoyés quelque part ?
faq.answer: Non. Tout se passe localement dans votre navigateur — les mots de passe ne sont jamais transmis ni stockés sur un serveur.

faq.question: Qu'est-ce qui rend un mot de passe fort ?
faq.answer: La longueur compte le plus. Un mot de passe long combinant majuscules, minuscules, chiffres et symboles est bien plus difficile à déchiffrer qu'un mot de passe court et simple.

faq.question: Can I exclude ambiguous characters like 0, O, l, and 1?
faq.answer: No, there's no option to exclude visually similar characters — all characters from your selected categories (uppercase, lowercase, numbers, symbols) are equally eligible.

faq.question: What's the maximum password length I can generate?
faq.answer: You can generate passwords well beyond typical requirements, though most sites cap accepted lengths, so check the target system's limit before using a very long one.

faq.question: Does it guarantee at least one character from each selected category?
faq.answer: No, characters are picked uniformly at random from the combined set of selected categories, so it's statistically likely but not guaranteed that every category appears in a given password.

faq.question: Is it better to use a long passphrase or a random password?
faq.answer: Both can be strong — a long random password packs more entropy per character, while a passphrase of several random words is easier to type and remember; this tool is built for the random-character approach.

faq.question: Quels formats de casse sont pris en charge ?
faq.answer: MAJUSCULES, minuscules, Casse de Titre, casse de phrase, camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case et kebab-case.

faq.question: Cela modifie-t-il mon texte original ?
faq.answer: Non, votre saisie reste intacte — le résultat converti est affiché séparément afin que vous puissiez comparer ou convertir à nouveau.

faq.question: Y a-t-il une limite de longueur ?
faq.answer: Aucune limite pratique — la conversion se fait instantanément dans votre navigateur, même pour un texte long.

faq.question: How does it decide word boundaries when converting from camelCase or snake_case?
faq.answer: It splits on case transitions, underscores, hyphens, and spaces to detect word boundaries before reassembling into the target case format.

faq.question: Does it preserve acronyms when converting case?
faq.answer: Acronyms are treated like any other run of letters and will be reformatted to match the target case (e.g. lowercase in kebab-case), not preserved as-is.

faq.question: Can I convert multiple lines at once?
faq.answer: Yes, the whole text block you paste in is converted as one unit, so multiple lines convert together.

faq.question: What case types are supported?
faq.answer: UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case, Sentence case, camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, and kebab-case are all available.

howTo.name: Prévisualisez la lisibilité
howTo.text: Voyez du texte d'exemple en direct rendu dans vos couleurs choisies en tailles normale et grande.

faq.question: Comment le ratio de contraste est-il calculé ?
faq.answer: En utilisant la formule officielle de luminance relative WCAG 2.x, qui corrige le gamma de chaque canal de couleur avant de le pondérer selon la perception de luminance humaine.

faq.question: Quelle est la différence entre AA et AAA ?
faq.answer: AA est l'exigence d'accessibilité standard (4,5:1 pour le texte normal, 3:1 pour le texte grand) ; AAA est une exigence renforcée plus stricte (7:1 et 4,5:1 respectivement).

faq.question: Qu'est-ce qui compte comme 'texte grand' ?
faq.answer: Un texte de 18pt ou plus, ou de 14pt en gras, est éligible aux seuils plus souples du texte grand.

faq.question: Does this tool check contrast for UI elements, not just text?
faq.answer: No, it checks the four standard text-contrast thresholds (AA and AAA, normal and large text) only — it doesn't check the separate 3:1 ratio WCAG requires for non-text UI components and graphical objects.

faq.question: Can I enter colors as HEX, RGB, or color names?
faq.answer: Most versions accept HEX codes and RGB values directly; check the input field for which formats are supported before typing in a color name.

faq.question: Why did my colors pass AA but fail AAA?
faq.answer: AAA requires a stricter 7:1 ratio for normal text compared to AA's 4.5:1, so a color pair with moderate contrast can satisfy the more lenient AA standard while falling short of AAA.

faq.question: What's the difference between AA and AAA compliance?
faq.answer: AA is the standard minimum most sites aim for (4.5:1 for normal text); AAA is a stricter, optional level (7:1) recommended for content aimed at users with low vision.

svg-optimizer.metaDescription: Optimisez et nettoyez le balisage SVG en supprimant les commentaires, métadonnées et IDs inutilisés, et en arrondissant la précision des chemins — traité à 100% localement dans votre navigateur.

howTo.text: Activez la suppression des commentaires, le nettoyage des métadonnées, le nettoyage des IDs inutilisés et l'arrondi de précision.

howTo.name: Comparez et exportez
howTo.text: Voyez la taille économisée et l'aperçu avant/après, puis copiez ou téléchargez le SVG optimisé.

faq.question: L'optimisation va-t-elle changer l'apparence de mon SVG ?
faq.answer: Non, toutes les optimisations sont visuellement sans perte — seul le balisage redondant comme les commentaires, IDs inutilisés et précision décimale excessive est supprimé.

faq.question: Que fait 'nettoyer les IDs inutilisés' ?
faq.answer: Cela scanne le SVG à la recherche d'attributs id jamais référencés ailleurs (via url(#id) ou href) et les supprime, car les IDs non référencés ajoutent de la taille sans aucun but.

faq.question: Mon SVG est-il téléversé quelque part ?
faq.answer: Non, l'optimisation se fait entièrement dans votre navigateur.

faq.question: What specific things does the optimizer clean up?
faq.answer: It removes comments, strips metadata/title/description elements, cleans up unused ID attributes, and rounds numeric precision in path and shape coordinates — it doesn't simplify path geometry itself.

faq.question: Will optimizing break animations or JavaScript that references my SVG's IDs?
faq.answer: IDs that are actually referenced (via url() or href) are preserved — only genuinely unused IDs are removed, but double-check any external JavaScript that references IDs indirectly.

faq.question: How much smaller does an SVG typically get after optimizing?
faq.answer: This varies widely depending on how much unnecessary markup, comments, and excess decimal precision the original file contains — hand-exported SVGs from design tools often shrink noticeably more than already-clean ones.

faq.question: Can I paste raw SVG markup instead of uploading a file?
faq.answer: Yes, you can either paste SVG code directly into the text area or upload an .svg file.

howTo.text: Copiez le texte nettoyé avec tous les caractères invisibles supprimés.

faq.question: D'où viennent les caractères invisibles ?
faq.answer: Ils sont souvent introduits accidentellement en copiant du texte depuis des traitements de texte, des liens de suivi ou des applications de messagerie.

faq.question: Quels caractères sont supprimés ?
faq.answer: Espaces de largeur nulle, joints/non-joints de largeur nulle, marqueurs d'ordre d'octets, joints de mots, traits d'union conditionnels, et caractères de contrôle bidirectionnels isolés.

faq.question: Mon texte est-il envoyé quelque part ?
faq.answer: Non, le nettoyage se fait entièrement dans votre navigateur — rien n'est téléversé.

faq.question: Does it detect characters I can't normally see in a text editor?
faq.answer: Yes, it scans for zero-width spaces, joiners, and other invisible Unicode characters that render as nothing in most editors.

faq.question: Can it show me a count of how many invisible characters were found?
faq.answer: Yes, the tool reports exactly how many invisible characters were found and removed from your text.

faq.question: Will this remove legitimate formatting characters like non-breaking spaces?
faq.answer: Only zero-width and other genuinely invisible characters are targeted — verify the specific character set covered if you rely on non-breaking spaces for layout, since removal behavior depends on which characters are flagged.

faq.question: Why would invisible characters break my code or CMS content?
faq.answer: Zero-width characters can silently break string comparisons, search functionality, and copy-pasted code — since they're invisible, they're difficult to spot without a tool like this.

howTo.name: Copiez ou téléchargez le résultat
howTo.text: Copiez le résultat converti ou téléchargez-le en fichier.

faq.question: Est-ce une implémentation complète de YAML ?
faq.answer: Cela couvre le sous-ensemble pratique de YAML utilisé par la plupart des fichiers de configuration — objets imbriqués, listes en style bloc, chaînes, nombres, booléens et null — plutôt que chaque cas particulier de la spécification complète.

faq.question: Mes données sont-elles téléversées quelque part ?
faq.answer: Non, la conversion se fait entièrement dans votre navigateur.

faq.question: Puis-je convertir des structures imbriquées complexes ?
faq.answer: Oui, les deux directions gèrent les objets profondément imbriqués et les tableaux d'objets.

faq.question: How does it represent JSON null values in YAML?
faq.answer: JSON null values are written as the literal `null` in the YAML output, matching standard YAML convention.

faq.question: Are YAML anchors and aliases supported when converting back to JSON?
faq.answer: No, anchors (&) and aliases (*) aren't recognized by the parser — pasted YAML using them won't convert correctly.

faq.question: Does indentation matter when pasting YAML in?
faq.answer: Yes, the parser reads structure from indentation levels, so inconsistent or incorrect indentation in pasted YAML can produce an incorrect or failed conversion.

faq.question: Can it round-trip YAML comments?
faq.answer: No, comments (lines or trailing text starting with #) are stripped when parsing YAML back to JSON — JSON itself has no comment syntax to preserve them in.

howTo.text: Choisissez un ordre de tri, puis copiez la liste nettoyée.

faq.question: Quelle ligne est conservée en cas de doublons ?
faq.answer: La première occurrence est conservée, avec sa casse d'origine préservée même en mode insensible à la casse.

faq.question: Puis-je trier sans supprimer les doublons ?
faq.answer: Oui, le tri et la déduplication sont des options indépendantes — utilisez l'une ou l'autre, ou les deux ensemble.

faq.question: Ma liste est-elle téléversée quelque part ?
faq.answer: Non, tout est traité entièrement dans votre navigateur.

faq.question: Is duplicate detection case-sensitive?
faq.answer: There's a case-insensitive toggle — by default it may treat "Apple" and "apple" as different lines unless you enable case-insensitive comparison.

faq.question: Does it ignore leading or trailing whitespace when comparing lines?
faq.answer: Check how your lines are compared — trimming behavior affects whether lines that differ only in surrounding whitespace are treated as duplicates.

faq.question: What sorting options are available besides alphabetical?
faq.answer: You can sort A→Z, Z→A, by line length, or leave the original order unchanged — there's no separate numeric-value sort mode.

faq.question: Can I remove blank lines at the same time?
faq.answer: Yes, a separate "remove empty lines" option works independently of duplicate removal.

hmac-generator.metaDescription: Générez un hachage à clé HMAC à partir d'un message et d'une clé secrète en utilisant SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384 ou SHA-512 — calculé localement dans votre navigateur.

faq.question: Comment le HMAC est-il calculé ?
faq.answer: À l'aide de l'API Web Crypto native de votre navigateur (crypto.subtle), qui signe de manière sécurisée le message avec votre clé selon l'algorithme de hachage sélectionné.

faq.question: Ma clé secrète est-elle envoyée quelque part ?
faq.answer: Non, tout est calculé localement dans votre navigateur — votre clé et votre message ne sont jamais transmis.

faq.question: Quelle est la différence entre HMAC et un hachage simple ?
faq.answer: Un hachage simple n'a pas de clé secrète, donc n'importe qui peut le calculer. Un HMAC combine une clé secrète avec le message, vous permettant de vérifier à la fois l'intégrité et l'authenticité.

faq.question: Which hash algorithms can I use for the HMAC?
faq.answer: HMAC can be computed with SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, or SHA-512 as the underlying hash function, matching what's available in the Web Crypto API.

faq.question: Can the secret key be any text, or does it need to be hex?
faq.answer: The secret is always treated as plain text and UTF-8 encoded before use — there's no hex or Base64 key-encoding mode, so enter the key exactly as plain text.

faq.question: Why would I use HMAC instead of just hashing the message?
faq.answer: A plain hash proves the message wasn't altered but anyone can compute it; HMAC also requires knowledge of a shared secret key, so it proves the message came from someone who holds that key.

faq.question: Can this verify an HMAC signature I received, like a webhook signature?
faq.answer: Yes, you can recompute the HMAC from the message and secret and compare it to the received signature manually, though the tool doesn't automate the comparison for you.

faq.question: Quel format JSON fonctionne le mieux ?
faq.answer: Un tableau d'objets plats avec des clés cohérentes, par exemple [{"nom": "A", "prix": 10}, ...] — cela se mappe proprement en lignes et colonnes de tableur.

faq.question: Que se passe-t-il avec les objets imbriqués ?
faq.answer: Les valeurs profondément imbriquées sont aplaties ou converties en texte lorsque possible pour qu'elles tiennent dans une cellule CSV.

faq.question: Mes données sont-elles téléversées quelque part ?
faq.answer: Non, la conversion se fait entièrement dans votre navigateur.

faq.question: Can I choose which fields get exported as columns?
faq.answer: No, all fields present across your JSON objects are automatically included as columns — there's no field-selection option.

faq.question: How are commas or quotes inside values handled?
faq.answer: Values containing commas, quotes, or newlines are automatically wrapped in quotes and escaped per standard CSV formatting rules.

faq.question: Does column order match the order of keys in my JSON?
faq.answer: Columns are generally derived from the keys found across your JSON objects — for consistent column order, ensure your JSON objects have keys in the same order.

faq.question: Can I download the result directly as a .csv file?
faq.answer: Yes, a dedicated download button saves the converted output as a .csv file.

howTo.text: Cliquez sur Minifier, puis copiez le résultat compressé — voyez combien d'espace vous avez économisé.

faq.question: La minification va-t-elle casser mon code ?
faq.answer: Non, seuls les commentaires et les espaces sûrs sont supprimés — le contenu à l'intérieur des balises pre, textarea, script et style pour le HTML, et les littéraux de chaîne pour le CSS, sont préservés intacts.

faq.question: Combien d'espace la minification économise-t-elle ?
faq.answer: Cela varie selon la quantité d'espaces et de commentaires de votre code original — l'outil affiche une comparaison exacte de la taille avant/après.

faq.question: Mon code est-il téléversé quelque part ?
faq.answer: Non, la minification se fait entièrement dans votre navigateur.

faq.question: Does it minify JavaScript as well as HTML and CSS?
faq.answer: No, only HTML and CSS minification modes are available — there's no JavaScript minifier.

faq.question: Are HTML comments always removed?
faq.answer: Yes, HTML comments are stripped automatically during minification with no option to preserve them.

faq.question: Does minifying CSS remove unused rules?
faq.answer: No, CSS minification only removes comments and unnecessary whitespace/formatting — it doesn't analyze your HTML to detect and remove unused selectors.

faq.question: Can I reverse minification to get readable code back?
faq.answer: No, minification is one-directional and doesn't preserve original formatting or variable names to reconstruct — keep a copy of your original code if you'll need to edit it later.

faq.question: Y a-t-il une limite de temps ou un filigrane ?
faq.answer: Non, les enregistrements n'ont aucune limite de temps artificielle ni filigrane — cela utilise directement l'API d'enregistrement native de votre navigateur.

faq.question: Mon enregistrement est-il téléversé quelque part ?
faq.answer: Non, l'enregistrement et le traitement se font entièrement sur votre appareil — rien n'est envoyé à un serveur.

faq.question: Puis-je enregistrer avec de l'audio ?
faq.answer: Oui, vous pouvez inclure votre microphone, et l'audio de l'onglet partagé est capturé automatiquement lorsque votre navigateur le prend en charge.

faq.question: What video format does the recording download as?
faq.answer: Recordings are saved as WebM, using VP8 or VP9 video with Opus audio depending on what your browser supports.

faq.question: Can I record just one browser tab instead of my whole screen?
faq.answer: Yes, but the choice between full screen, a window, or a specific tab comes from your browser's own native screen-sharing picker, not a setting inside this tool.

faq.question: Why does my browser ask for permission every time I record?
faq.answer: Browsers require explicit screen-capture permission each session for privacy — this tool has no way to remember or bypass that browser-level prompt.

faq.question: Does system audio get captured along with my microphone?
faq.answer: Yes, if you share audio in your browser's screen-share prompt, system/tab audio is captured separately from your microphone (when microphone capture is also enabled), and both are combined in the recording.

howTo.name: Copiez le résultat
howTo.text: Copiez le résultat encodé ou décodé dans votre presse-papiers.

faq.question: Pourquoi encoder des entités HTML ?
faq.answer: Pour afficher en toute sécurité des caractères spéciaux comme <, > et & en tant que texte littéral dans du HTML, sans que le navigateur les interprète comme du balisage.

faq.question: Quelles entités peuvent être décodées ?
faq.answer: Toutes les entités HTML nommées et numériques que votre navigateur reconnaît — le décodage utilise le propre analyseur HTML du navigateur pour une couverture complète et précise.

faq.question: Mon texte est-il téléversé quelque part ?
faq.answer: Non, l'encodage et le décodage se font entièrement dans votre navigateur.

faq.question: Does it encode all non-ASCII characters or just special ones?
faq.answer: By default it targets characters with reserved meaning in HTML, like <, >, &, and quotes; there's a separate option to encode all non-ASCII characters as numeric entities if you need that.

faq.question: What's the difference between named and numeric entities?
faq.answer: Named entities like & are more readable, while numeric entities like & work for any Unicode code point, including ones without a defined name — this tool can output either.

faq.question: Why do I need to encode characters like & in HTML attributes?
faq.answer: Unencoded & or quote characters inside attribute values can break the HTML parser or be misread as marking the start of an entity, so encoding keeps the attribute value intact.

faq.question: Can decoding handle entities without a trailing semicolon?
faq.answer: Most browsers tolerate some named entities without a semicolon, but this decoder expects well-formed entities ending in a semicolon for reliable results.

exif-stripper.seoTitle: Suppresseur de Métadonnées EXIF et GPS – Gratuit et Privé, Sans Téléversement
exif-stripper.metaDescription: Affichez et supprimez les métadonnées EXIF — modèle d'appareil photo, position GPS, horodatage — de vos photos avant de les partager, entièrement dans votre navigateur.
